# ORACHITECH

ORACHITECH, also known as Orachi Tech, is an independent digital product design and software engineering studio in Lahore, Pakistan, working with teams worldwide.

Website: https://www.orachitech.com
Email: info@orachitech.com
Phone: +92 323 359 3780
Location: Lahore, Pakistan

## Capabilities

- Digital product strategy
- UX and interface design
- Custom web applications
- SaaS product development
- Mobile application development
- Cloud systems and integrations
- Data platforms and workflow automation
- Product modernization and technical consulting

## Focus

ORACHITECH helps ambitious teams turn complex operations and product ideas into clear, dependable digital experiences. The studio works across strategy, design, engineering, systems integration, automation, and long-term product evolution.
